prompt:
Rhombus LMNO is shown with its diagonals.

Rhombus L M N O is shown. Diagonals are drawn from point L to point N and from point M to point O and intersect at point P. All sides are congruent.

Angle MNO measures 112°. What is the measure of angle LMN?

34°
45°
56°
68°
judge_reasoning: For a rhombus, adjacent interior angles are supplementary. Since angle MNO is 112°, angle LMN (at the adjacent vertex M) is 180°−112°=68°. Candidate [1] gives 68° as the final answer, while candidates [2], [3], and [4] give 56°, 34°, and 44° respectively, all of which do not match 68°.
